text:
rachel: quick heads-up  Silverleaf Bio submitted a private onboarding for a 7B "chem-safety" model. Requirements: customer-managed HSM (FIPS), strict PHI/PII redaction, deterministic logits recording for audit, and nightly redacted trace exports. They want GA in ~3 weeks. I uploaded intake + samples.

samir: Got it. Do we have artifact format and perf targets? Streaming vs non-streaming?

rachel: Artifact: HF safetensors + tokenizer. They plan int8 quant but emphasize determinism for reproducible outputs (for legal trace). Throughput: steady 8 QPS, bursts 45. Target p50 <200ms for 512 tokens. Canary 30 days, auto-rollback on safety or determinism drift.

lia: Important asks: token-level provenance must be stored (redacted), and nightly CSV must not include raw user identifiers. Ask them to provide a PHI whitelist/blacklist and the exact provenance fields required. Also request a 200-example failure set and a 1k safety prompt pack.

deploy-bot: Intake logged: SL-ONB-2026-551  assigned: cs-ops  priority: P1  ticket: CS-ONB-9021

samir: I'll schedule a cross-team sync (eng + privacy + infra) tomorrow 9am PT. @lia will you own the eval harness? We also need to confirm whether weights live in customer S3 (BYO) or our storage.

lia: I'll take evals. Plan: run baseline vs redwood-7b-v2 on 5k prompts, include determinism checks (hash of logits), NER F1, hallucination delta, and phi_leak. Quick harness: 
``` 
./eval_harness --model s3://silverleaf/model.safetensors \ 
               --prompts gs://redwood-cs/silverleaf/safety_pack_v1.csv \ 
               --baseline redwood-7b-v2 \ 
               --metrics ner_f1,hallucination,phi_leak,determinism,latency
```
I'll test int8 and a 4-bit fallback if perf/quality tradeoffs require it. Expect first-pass within 48hrs.

rachel: Procurement flagged renewal risk if p50 >250ms at GA. Theyre sensitive to latency. Also they need quarterly HSM attestations.

samir: If int8 can't hit p50 target we recommend Dedicated with token-aware batching or kernel tuning. For rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 14 days; auto-rollback on evidence F1 drop >2% or any PHI leakage incident. Documenting rollout policy now.

lia: One quick ops Q: do they require inference inside their VPC? If yes, we need peering + cross-account role + HSM provisioning notes. Asking the customer now.

rachel: Customer prefers our private infra with customer-managed HSM but is open to VPC peering if we can't meet determinism SLOs. I'll update intake with the PHI whitelist request and the provenance schema.

samir: Great. We'll cover infra, determinism checks, and compliance in tomorrow's sync. I'll post meeting notes and the eval results here.
